metadata.dcterms:title: GEOMETRIC TRIANGULATIONS OF A FAMILY OF HYPERBOLIC 3-BRAIDS
metadata.dcterms:creator: NIMERSHIEM, BARBARA
metadata.dcterms:abstract: We construct topological triangulations for complements of (−2, 3, n)-pretzel knots and links with n ≥7. Following a procedure outlined by Futer and Gu´eritaud, we use a theorem of Casson and Rivin to prove the constructed triangulations are geometric. Futer, Kalfagianni, and Purcell have shown (indirectly) that such braids are hyperbolic. The new result here is a direct proof.
